title: Switch Statement
subStepTitle: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
subcategory: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
problemStatement: Dispatch on a discrete set of labels. Python 3.10+ has match/case; older style uses if/elif.
intuition: Exact finite labels → switch/match. Always define the default path.

approaches.title: match/case
approaches.code:
def day_name(d: int) -> str:
    match d:
        case 1:
            return "mon"
        case 2:
            return "tue"
        case 3:
            return "wed"
        case _:
            return "other"

followUps: When prefer polymorphism over type-code switches?
interviewInsight: Large type-code switches often want Strategy/polymorphism in design rounds.
